title: Compactness theorem for Radon measures, corrected (Simon 4.16 with erratum)
statement: For every second countable locally compact Hausdorff space X and every sequence of Radon outer measures μ_k on X with sup_k μ_k(K) < ∞ for each compact K, there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and a Radon outer measure μ on X with ∫ f dμ_{φ(k)} → ∫ f dμ for every continuous compactly supported f : X → ℝ.
